description: Land Settlement Department - Abhayapura, Lankapura D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120271 (24/1008)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Plot 1:7, Block 1) in Abhayapura village, including details about the land extent, owner information, and legal status. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land property matters, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
